clauses.condition_explanation: within_copyright_and_similar_rights_term means the term of the Copyright and Similar Rights licensed here has not expired. license_rights_not_automatically_terminated_by_noncompliance means You have not failed to comply with the Public License in a way that automatically terminates Your rights.

clauses.scope_note: Section 6(b)(1): rights to use Licensed Material that terminated under Section 6(a) reinstate automatically as of the cure date if the violation is cured within 30 days of discovery.
clauses.condition_explanation: rights_terminated_under_section_6a means the right to use the Licensed Material terminated under Section 6(a). violation_cured_within_30_days_of_discovery means the violation is cured no later than 30 days after You discover it. Reinstatement is automatic as of the date of cure when both predicates hold.

clauses.scope_note: Section 6(b)(2): an alternative to automatic reinstatement under Section 6(b)(1), for rights terminated under Section 6(a).
clauses.condition_explanation: rights_terminated_under_section_6a means the right to use the Licensed Material terminated under Section 6(a). licensor_expressly_reinstates_rights means the Licensor expressly reinstates those rights.

clauses.condition_explanation: use_lawfully_possible_without_license_permission means the particular use could lawfully be made without permission under this Public License.
